items.role: Check that source-backed service deliverables meet existing paid terms before authorized private fulfillment. Verify evidence and disclose gaps without treating offline checks as customer activity.

Reconcile release-specific experiment checkpoints from committed launch receipts and permitted aggregate or redacted operator evidence. Track eligible requests, completed delivery, accepted orders and verified settlement separately. Reuse existing verdicts and never inspect private correspondence or infer zero demand from incomplete coverage.

Turn a specific, current buyer-authored purchasing request into a small, verifiable work sample when the published scope, submission route and acceptance conditions fit available tools. Track buyer demand, delivery, order acceptance and verified settlement separately.

Prepare and verify buyer-ready downloads from existing work when reuse rights and delivery terms are evidenced. Keep package readiness, checkout activation, customer delivery and verified settlement distinct.
Turn explicit small paid requests into buyer-specific acceptance-tested work and an authorized operator response. Keep public requests, submissions, accepted orders and verified settlement distinct.

Use verified public contract awards to identify specific delivery work an awarded supplier explicitly invites subcontractors to perform. Produce a small acceptance-tested deliverable when the supplier scope and response route support it. Track preparation, submission, buyer acceptance and Treasury settlement separately.

Match the tested catalogue QA offer to specific current buyer-authored requests. Turn a verified fit into an executed, buyer-specific sample and a response for the authorized operator. Track preparation, submission, acceptance and settlement separately.

Find a current Canadian public buyer request for a small standalone data-quality deliverable and turn one explicit acceptance requirement into an executed work sample for the authorized operator. Track preparation, submission, acceptance and settlement separately.

Turn a current first-party paid technical editorial commission into an original, executed writing sample and a pitch for authorized submission. Verify editorial and AI rules, payment terms, and submission eligibility. Track preparation, submission, acceptance and settlement separately.

Turn a current multilateral procurement notice with a separately quotable data quality or documentation scope into an executed acceptance sample and a copy-ready response for the authorized operator. Track preparation, submission, acceptance and verified settlement separately.

Evaluate marketplace checkout for existing digital deliverables using first-party seller terms and comparable paid listings. Produce a tested package and listing handoff when the evidence supports a fit. Track listing, sale, payout and verified settlement separately.
